text:
dana: Planning to cut RC-7412 into the nightly change window at 00:30 UTC. Quick checklist: artifact pin, KV warm, sheriff ack, DB flag toggle readiness, and rollback play. Who can own the sheriff for the window?
prod-deploy-bot: Candidate RC-7412 created from branch `main@f2c4a9d`. Artifacts pinned: `inference-service:7412` (sha: abcdef123456). Can start bake when requested.
mike: I can take sheriff for the midnight window. Will be on standby 00:15-01:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
sarah: Heads up — there's a late db-migration PR still queued (db-migrate/372). It touches feature flags used by the new model routing. We should either block the migration or delay the RC by an hour.
dana: Thanks. Mike can you confirm whether the change is safe to proceed if the migration lands? We need a go/no-go by 23:45 UTC.
mike: Quick look: migration has a fallback, but it changes the `routing_version` column. If it lands before we flip, we need to re-pin traffic to legacy routing. Doesn't look catastrophic, but increases rollback blast radius. Recommend holding migration until after RC promo.
alex_oncall: If we proceed we should ensure rollback signal is sharp. Proposed rollback command (manual):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference-service inference-service=redwood/inference:7412-rollback
# then toggle flag
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/flags -d '{"routing_version":"legacy"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
```
steve_release: Also add a deploy bot quick-check before cutting: `deploybot preflight --rc=7412 --kv-warm --canary=0` so we get an automated smoke.
prod-deploy-bot: Preflight started for RC-7412. KV warm check: pending. Canary config: 0% (manual). Smoke runner queued.
sarah: Can we run KV warm now? I can trigger the warm step against staging to reduce first-request latency.
dana: Yes please run it and report back within 15 minutes. If KV warm fails we delay promo.
prod-deploy-bot: KV warm completed (staging): hotkeys: 12/12 primed. Smoke runner: 1/1 ok (simple text gen). No errors in logs.
mike: Good. I've updated the ops doc with the rollback URL and tagged the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/rc-rollback. Also added the db-migration owner tag so they hold until 01:00 UTC.
dana: OK — final checks: Mike = sheriff, Sarah = migration hold, Alex = oncall rollback exec, Steve = deploy lead. Any objections to cutting at 00:30 UTC?
steve_release: No objections. I'll kick the promo at 00:30 and watch the deploybot.
prod-deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: RC-7412 -> prod at 00:30 UTC. Will execute KV warm check, then pin artifacts, then canary traffic 5% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Auto-fallback to legacy routing if health degrade > 5% error rate.
alex_oncall: If anything hits >5% errors during canary, I will abort and run the rollback command above.
dana: Thanks everyone. Roger to proceed. See you in the channel at 00:25 for final green. :rocket:
